Usage: updatecli mcp [--help]

  Starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server that exposes
  Windows Update diagnostic tools to AI agents and IDE extensions.

  The server reads JSON-RPC 2.0 requests from stdin and writes
  responses to stdout using newline-delimited JSON (one JSON object
  per line, no Content-Length headers).

Options:
  --help    Display this help message

VS Code / Copilot configuration:

  Add the following to your MCP configuration file
  (e.g. ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json):

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "updatecli": {
          "type": "stdio",
          "command": "updatecli",
          "args": ["mcp"]
        }
      }
    }

Protocol details:
  Transport:  stdio (newline-delimited JSON)
  Spec:       https://modelcontextprotocol.io
  Version:    2024-11-05

  Each request and response is a single JSON object on one line.
  Messages MUST NOT contain embedded newlines.
